verdict.rationale: TruffleHog ships a well-documented official CLI (installable via brew/docker) with a rich set of subcommands and flags (git, github, scan, analyze, --include-detectors, --verify-detectors, --fail, --results) suitable for scripted/agentic invocation, and is explicitly used in automation contexts like pre-commit hooks and CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of machine-readable (JSON) output formats or exit-code semantics tailored for agent/automation consumption, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs/GitHub.
